OPTIONAL: server.py now ~2634 lines with SURVIVAL EXTENSIONS block at bottom. Recommend extracting acoustic/pharmacy/pulse/survival into separate route modules before Publish.
critical_code_review_comments: Pulse Check opt-in gate at server.py:2561 correctly rejects with 403 'opt_in_required: …' BEFORE creating a pulse_requests record — good privacy hygiene (no silent record creation for un-opted targets). Frontend pulse-check.tsx maps 'opt_in_required' substring to Slovak friendly message on send failure.

Pharmacy simulator uses deterministic SHA-256(med|chain|city) hashing so results are STABLE across polls (same med+region → same status) — this makes SKEN semantically meaningful (only real change is if user watches long enough for hash-slot to cycle). Documented DEMO badge in UI is correct.

Acoustic event endpoint currently accepts any user (no angel_mode gate) — this is fine but means non-Angel users could POST events. Consider `if not user.get('angel_mode'): raise 403` if strict Angel-Mode-only enforcement is desired. Current behavior is permissive by design (family monitor can also log events).

Second user seeding via test_phase9.py fixture correctly $unsets pulse_check_optin so the initial 403 test is deterministic across re-runs. Session token TOKEN2='smoketok-fresh-2026-u2' persists 7 days.

Survival Bible PDF pulls from 7 collections (emergency_profiles, proxy_directives, legal_testaments, med_reminders, cabinet, waitlist, biometric_wills) + hardcoded MENTAL_TECHNIQUES_SK. Uses _auth_pdf helper for dual-auth (header OR ?token=). PDF size ~10-15KB even with sparse data — verified by test.
